  2. Publiceer of corrigeer het DNS-record voor “DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen” volgens de huidige syntax.

en.bodyHtml:
DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen belongs in DNS (TXT): one SPF, DKIM selectors and DMARC policy. Multiple SPF records break authentication.

Without auth, messages land in spam or get rejected.

What this article covers

You carry out “DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen” via mailbox, client and DNS auth, with backup awareness and verification.

Unique checkpoints

This long-form guide is written for DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen (slug dmarc-aggregate-reports-rua-lezen).

Signals from title/topic: dmarc, aggregate, reports, rua, lezen. Stay in the matching layer — do not mix DNS edits with wp-admin fixes unless this topic explicitly requires it.

  • If there is an error: keep the exact text for “DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen” — paraphrasing slows support.
  • When unsure between panel A and B: pick the layer topic tz-w2-th-mail-dmarc-aggregate-reports-rua-lezen-368ae implies.
  • Confirm you are on the correct product/domain before applying “DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen”.

Scope

Internal classification: topic tz-w2-th-mail-dmarc-aggregate-reports-rua-lezen-368ae — include that context in tickets about “DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen”.

What you need

  • DNS access
  • List of legitimate sending sources

How to execute

  1. Inventory every service that sends for the domain (hosting, Microsoft, ESP).
  2. Publish or fix the DNS record for “DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen” with current syntax.
  3. Keep at most one SPF TXT on @.
  4. Wait for propagation; test with header analysis on a received message.
  5. Raise DMARC from none → quarantine/reject only when reports are clean.
  6. Repeat the core check for “DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen” from a second network or private window.

Verify

  • Auth=pass in headers.
  • No duplicate SPF.
  • Article check dmarc-aggregate-reports-rua-lezen: “DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen” yields the expected result without regressing web/mail/DNS.

Pitfalls

  • Separate SPF per tool instead of merging includes.

If it goes wrong

  1. Restore the previous value you noted for “DMARC aggregate reports (RUA) lezen”.
  2. Restore from backup only if the live state is corrupt — selectively where possible.
  3. Open a ticket with slug/subject, domain and what you already rolled back.

Practical tip

Tip: Start DMARC at p=none with rua reporting.

Note: DMARC reject without SPF/DKIM coverage stops legitimate mail.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
